title: Evaluation After Boolean-Function Reindexing
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $e\colon\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\simeq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be a bijection, let $f\colon\{-1,1\}^m\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The reindexed function evaluated at $x$ equals $f$ evaluated on the input whose $i$th coordinate is $x_{e(i)}$.
hypotheses_covered: $e$ is a bijection between their coordinate sets
$f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on $m$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector on $n$ coordinates
